description: Synthetic case: AI clinical decision support system recommends a medication change for a patient. Recommendation is generated by a language model and submitted for authorization before the EHR record is updated.

patient_flags.reason: Mental health diagnosis present in record
patient_flags._note: The dual-authorization requirement for sensitive_category is an Evolve / organizational policy interpretation applied on top of HIPAA framework requirements. HIPAA §164.312(a)(1) requires unique user identification and access control — it does not prescribe dual authorization explicitly. The dual-authorization rule is a local operational policy the organization has adopted to satisfy the minimum necessary standard for sensitive categories. Kept distinct from framework requirements in this case file.
